fact: Ley Núm. 1/2016 of 22 July 2016, sanctioned and promulgated by the President, sets rules for personal data processing in the public and private sectors and enters into force twenty days after its publication in the Boletín Oficial del Estado (date taken from the law's own date, 22 July 2016).

fact: The African Union Infrastructure and Energy Department reports that Equatorial Guinea's foreign minister signed the Malabo Convention in Addis Ababa on 28 July 2026, as a step towards ratification.
The African Union's status list of 2 February 2026 records no signature and no ratification of the Malabo Convention by Equatorial Guinea.
ACTPOL, citing the African Union status list of 2 February 2026, says Equatorial Guinea has taken no action on the Malabo Convention.
